glyph.isekai_mahou.haki_armament.desc: Arcane augment (One Piece tribute). Willpower hardens and blackens the blow: the spell's damage +10% and ignores 30% of the reduction from armor, protection enchantments and Resistance (copies stack: max 3, up to 75%). Hits intangible foes (undoes half of the reductions from ghost forms and magic skins) and strips Invisibility. When cast, your arms turn glossy black for 3 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.haki_observation.desc: Arcane effect (One Piece tribute). On you or an ally for 8 s (Extend +): sense every presence within 20 blocks (Expand +) — red (threats) and white outlines seen THROUGH walls, only by whoever has the Haki, refreshed every 2 s. It also "sees the future": 25% chance to dodge a blow or projectile (+8% per power level, max 50%; half against bosses; 1.5 s between dodges).
glyph.isekai_mahou.haki_conqueror.desc: Arcane effect (One Piece tribute). A king's will in black and red lightning. On the target — or on you, as a radius-8 wave (Expand +): weak creatures (health up to 60% of your max health × power) FAINT for 5 s; average ones (up to double) flee in terror for 4 s; strong ones are slowed. Bosses never fall (they're only Exposed) and enemy players just feel the pressure (short Slowness and Nausea). Deals no damage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gomu_pistol.desc: Arcane effect (One Piece tribute). Your arm stretches like rubber: a 7-damage punch (×1.25 bare-handed) that knocks back. On you: hits the first enemy ahead up to 10 blocks (Expand +). With other forms the arm flies to each target hit (up to 20 blocks). With Split it becomes GATLING: a barrage of 3 punches + 2 per Split (max 12), 45% damage each.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shinra_tensei.desc: Gravity effect (Naruto tribute — Pain). Repulsion. On the target: 4 damage and a strong shove away from you. On you: a radius-5 sphere (Expand +50% each, max 20) blasts every enemy away and bounces enemy projectiles back. The BIG version (radius 9 or more) is exhausting: for 5 s no big Shinra Tensei can be cast again. Bosses barely move. Breaks no blocks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.bansho_tenin.desc: Gravity effect (Naruto tribute — Pain). Attraction: pulls the target right in front of you (stronger the farther it is; bosses barely budge). On you: pulls up to 8 enemies within radius 8 (Expand +). With Invert, YOU fly to the target instead.
glyph.isekai_mahou.chibaku_tensei.desc: Gravity effect (Naruto tribute — Pain). A black core rises 5 blocks above the point (on you: 6 blocks ahead) and lifts every enemy within radius 7 (Expand +, max 16), trapping them in a spinning sphere for 6 s (Extend +, max 20 s) — 2.5 damage every 0.5 s. Rocks and dirt orbit around it (visual only: no block moves). Bosses aren't lifted: they get Slowness III. Max 16 trapped and 1 core of yours at a time.
glyph.isekai_mahou.paper_shuriken.desc: Wind effect (Naruto tribute — Konan). Razor-sharp sheets of paper cut the target 4 times over 0.6 s: 2.2 damage each and Bleeding on the last cut. On you: a radius-4 paper whirlwind (Expand +, max 12) that cuts up to 12 enemies. With Expand and area forms it becomes Konan's Paper Ocean.
glyph.isekai_mahou.paper_wings.desc: Wind augment (Naruto tribute — Konan). When the spell is cast, paper wings unfold on your back for 10 s (+5 s per copy, max 30 s): in the air you GLIDE where you look, falling slowly with no fall damage. Sneak to fold the wings.
glyph.isekai_mahou.amaterasu.desc: Hellfire effect (Naruto tribute — Itachi and Sasuke). BLACK flames: 3 damage at once and the target burns for 6 s (Extend +, max 20 s; half on bosses), losing health every 0.5 s (stronger with Amplify). Water and rain DO NOT put them out. On you: your gaze ignites the first enemy you stare at within 24 blocks. Sets no blocks on fire.
glyph.isekai_mahou.susanoo.desc: Shadow effect (Naruto tribute — Mangekyō Sharingan). On you or an ally: Susanoo's giant spectral ribcage closes around the body for 10 s (Extend +, max 30 s) — damage taken −35% (−20% from bosses), +4 armor and knockback resistance. Every melee hit releases a spectral slash reaching 6 blocks. Casting again while Susanoo is active: a Totsuka Sword strike (9-block crescent). When it ends, Weakness for 5 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.chidori.desc: Lightning effect (Naruto tribute — Sasuke and Kakashi). "A thousand birds chirping": your hand fills with lightning and you charge. On you: an 8-block dash (Accelerate +, max 14) that PIERCES the first enemy and hits up to 3 along the way. With other forms: if the target is within 12 blocks and in sight, you appear right in front of it; too far, only the lightning arrives (70%). 10 Lightning damage and Shocked. With Amplify it becomes the pale-blue Raikiri.
glyph.isekai_mahou.kage_bunshin.desc: Shadow effect (Naruto tribute). Poof! 2 shadow clones (+1 per Split, max 5) with your skin and your weapon appear in a puff of smoke — around you or around the target hit — and fight for 15 s (Extend +). Each has 25% of your health, hits with 60% of your attack and vanishes on the 2nd hit taken. Monsters aiming at you may mistake a clone for you. In Peace Mode or inside cities they don't attack.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_i.shinra_lo: Big Shinra Tensei still recovering (%s s).
message.isekai_mahou.legends_i.foresight: You saw the blow before it happened!
